description: Daily, checks every active Xero Payroll AU employee for three milestones landing today: a 6-month probation step-up (6 months after StartDate), a recurring review (every 6 months after that, starting at the 6-month mark), and a junior birthday (turning 18, 19, 20 or 21 — checked against DateOfBirth). Xero has no native field for probation, review dates, or junior pay-rate tiers, so these are all computed from StartDate/DateOfBirth against a fixed 6-month policy, not read from Xero directly. For each milestone found, creates an org-visible WorkQ reminder and sends an email. Never writes anything back to Xero -- this only reminds a human to act.

flowIr.description: Daily, checks every active Xero Payroll AU employee for three milestones landing today: a 6-month probation step-up, a recurring 6-month review, and a junior birthday (18/19/20/21). Creates a WorkQ reminder and sends an email for each one found. Makes no changes to Xero.

nodes.summary: Lists active employees, fetches each one's full detail (StartDate/DateOfBirth aren't on the list summary), and flags anyone whose probation step-up, 6-month review, or junior birthday (18/19/20/21) lands on today's date.
nodes.title: Find today's milestones

nodes.code:
m = params["m"]
reminder_email = params["reminder_email"]

title_by_type = {
    "probation_step_up": "Probation step-up due",
    "review_due": "Review due",
    "junior_birthday": "Junior birthday -- check pay rate",
}
title = f"{title_by_type.get(m['milestone_type'], 'Payroll reminder')}: {m['employee_name']}"

api.workq.create(
    title=title,
    scope="org",
    description=m["detail_text"],
    labels=["payroll", m["milestone_type"]],
)

api.connectors.invoke(
    server="m365-mail-send",
    tool="send_email",
    args={
        "to": [reminder_email],
        "subject": title,
        "body": m["detail_text"],
        "contentType": "Text",
    },
)

sent = True

outputs.description: True once the WorkQ item and email for this milestone have both been created.
outputs.name: sent
